versions.content: Each call of the function Dem_- J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC shall search for the next event having a J1939DTC assigned and matching the filter criteria of Table 7.6 for the node provided by the function call of Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter . In case no more events are matching the filter criteria, the function return value shall be DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT. The out parameters need not to be valid in this case.
